visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a dark blue buttoned sweater sits on a white sofa. She speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and active hand gestures. The background features neutral-toned curtains and a plush pink pillow. (2) She holds up two sealed food packages, one white and one orange, showing them to the viewer while smiling brightly. (3) A shot of a set table shows a plate of golden-brown chicken nuggets, a bagel on a floral plate, a cup of black coffee, and a small mouse figurine. (4) Close-up shots of a black Philips air fryer opening to reveal golden chicken nuggets. A pair of wooden chopsticks picks up one nugget to show its texture. (5) A close-up of a nutrition label on the back of a food package is shown, followed by a cross-section of a nugget held by a fork, revealing white meat inside. (6) The woman takes a bite of the chicken nugget, nodding and looking pleased. (7) The air fryer is opened again to show a toasted bagel. The woman pulls the blueberry bagel apart with her hands, showing the creamy filling inside. (8) A white sachet of 'C3 Coffee' is poured into a beige ceramic cup, and steaming hot water is added from a light blue kettle. (9) The woman sits at the table with all the food items, gesturing toward them and giving two thumbs up while talking excitedly. (10) Final close-up of a nugget on a fork being held up to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright acoustic guitar BGM begins. A female voice speaks with high energy and clarity in Traditional Chinese. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as she emphasizes a point. (3) A distinct mechanical 'click' and 'clatter' of an air fryer basket being pulled out is heard. (4) A crisp 'crunch' sound effect accompanies the visual of someone biting into food. (5) Another 'whoosh' sound effect as the scene shifts to the bagel. (6) A sharp 'snap' sound when the bagel is pulled apart. (7) The sound of a plastic packet being torn followed by the granular sound of coffee powder falling into a cup. (8) A 'glug-glug' sound of liquid pouring as water is added to the cup. (9) A 'ding' bell sound effect signals a key piece of information regarding the group buy. (10) The female voice continues with a rising, persuasive intonation until the track ends with a final acoustic strum.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Statement (Guilt of Fried Food) -> Solution (Brand Introduction) -> Product Features (Nuggets/Bagel/Coffee) -> Taste Test Evidence -> Final Recommendation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Yuan Flavor' products (chicken nuggets, bagels, and coffee) as healthy, low-calorie alternatives for people on a fat-reduction diet, encouraging viewers to join a time-limited group buy.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly introduces the brand 'Yuan Flavor', demonstrates the products, and provides a group buy link with a deadline.
